thread:
Sam: Thanks everyone — quick follow-up from today's all-hands. Putting the Q&A notes + action items here so we don't lose anything. Thread below.

Maya: Can you confirm Dedicated GA target again? I thought roadmap said Q3 but we heard 'late Q2' verbally.

Sam: Good catch. Official target is still 'end of Q3' for GA. We said 'early customer pilots in late Q2' — I'll update the slide deck.

Chris: For the Dedicated SLA, what latency percentile are we committing to for the 99th? Is it regional or global?

Sam: 99p is regional by default, with global aggregation as an optional view. Target 99p is 250ms for small models, 350ms for medium models (initial commit). We'll publish the matrix in the SLO doc.

Lee: I'll own the rollout checklist for Dedicated pilots. Will sync with Eng-Infra and SRE next week. @Sam any preferred owners for customer comms?

Sam: Thanks Lee — put @Maya as primary comms owner, @Lee as infra owner, and @Chris as SLO/product owner.

Anita: Quick compliance follow-up: what's the retention default for audit logs in Private deployments? We need that to confirm with a government customer.

Sam: Default is 90 days, configurable up to 7 years with the compliance add-on. Anita — let's pair with Security to confirm KMS/HSM controls for that account.

Raj: Pricing question from a demo: Do we have a clear distinction between 'reserved capacity' billing vs 'consumption overage' during bursts?

Maya: Yes — reserved capacity is a monthly committed charge based on GPU pool size. Bursts use our 'burst credits' model (metered at a premium). I'll paste the pricing doc shortly.

DeployBot: Deployed: all-hands-slide-updates (sha: a1b2c3d) -> https://go/repo/changeset/a1b2c3d :white_check_mark:

Sam: Action items (owners):
- Maya: update public slide deck + pricing doc (due: 2411123000)
- Lee: rollout checklist + infra runbook for Dedicated pilots (due: 2411124000)
- Chris: publish SLO matrix + FAQ on regional vs global SLOs (due: 2411123600)
- Anita: confirm audit log retention/KMS details with Security, post in #eng-security (due: 2411123200)
- Raj: consolidate demo pricing Qs into a single doc and add to sales playbook (due: 2411123400)

Maya: links: deck (internal) https://drive.redwood/inference/allhands/slides, pricing draft https://go/pricing/draft — will update by EOD.

Chris: Adding a quick note on SLOs — we should include 'fallback model' behavior in the FAQ (i.e., when rolling to a lower-cost variant). I'll draft wording.

Lee: Can we add a short canary checklist item for KV cache warm-up? Saw one customer hit cold-cache latency spikes in a pilot.

Sam: Yes, add cache warm-up and a pre-warm window in rollout checklist.

Anita: FYI to the thread: Security will do a short writeup on compliance lanes (FedRAMP / ISO / SOC) and expected timelines for Private. I'll loop in @SecurityLead.

Maya: small ask — can folks add dependencies in their assigned GH issues and tag the release manager so we can sequence pilots?

Raj: Will do. I'll open a canonized 'demo-pricing' issue and tag @release-manager.

Sam: Final: we'll run a 30-min sync Monday to review owners and blockers. If you can't make it, drop updates in this thread before first_message_ts + 2 days. Thanks all. :rocket:
